title: fix(components): the form's built-in branches hand their control an allowlist, so a field-level `defaultValue` is no longer drawn (objectui#12155)
body:
Fixes #12155

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`renderFieldComponent` (`packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`) draws a field whose type no `field:` widget claims through a `switch` of built-in branches (`input`, `textarea`, `checkbox`, `switch`, `select`) and a `default` arm. Each spread the entry's leftover keys onto its control through a blocklist, `stripRendererOnlyProps`. As triage `6112522334` directs, every one of those spreads (the `domFieldProps` spreads and the `checkbox` / `switch` / `select` rests) now goes through the family's form-control allowlist `toFormControlDomProps`, and the blocklist is deleted:

- react-hook-form's `value`, `onChange` and `ref` reach each control BY NAME. The allowlist itself keeps `name`, `disabled` and `onBlur`.
- Per host element, one table, `BUILTIN_HOST_ATTRIBUTES`, forwards by name the native attributes a reader names: `min`, `max`, `step`, `minLength`, `pattern`, `multiple`, `accept` on an input; `rows`, `minLength` on a textarea.
- `maxLength`, `readOnly` and `placeholder` stay resolved by name, as before.

A field-level `defaultValue` or `defaultChecked` is no longer drawn, and nothing starts submitting it: a form's initial values stay `FormSchema.defaultValues`. `form-control-dom-props.ts` is not edited.

## Measured before building (BASE `c0c2f79`)

- **H1 held.** `const domFieldProps = stripRendererOnlyProps(fieldProps);` was the top of the built-in section, `checkboxProps` appeared twice, and both `form-control-dom-props.ts` and the effects pin were on `main`.
- **H2 held, through the real `SchemaRenderer`, in both registry sets.** A field-level `defaultValue` was DRAWN by the `textarea` branch (inline and fullscreen) and by the `default` arm (an unregistered type id in both sets; with components only also `text`, `email`, `number`), and never submitted. The `input` branch did not draw it (it writes `value` after the spread), but `defaultChecked` reached that input as a `checked` attribute. `checkbox` / `switch`: `defaultChecked` checked Radix's hidden bubble input while the box stayed `aria-checked="false"` and submitted `false`. `select`: the canary key reached the row (Leg A below). One effect the card did not name: on `input` with `inputType: 'file'`, a field-level `defaultValue` throws `InvalidStateError` and the whole form falls to `SchemaErrorBoundary`.
- **H3 did not hold. `toFormControlDomProps` drops keys that must reach the control.** I did NOT widen the allowlist. The keys, where each is documented or produced, and what this PR does:

| Key | Who documents or writes it for the built-in control | What the allowlist does | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value`, `onChange`, `ref` | react-hook-form's field binding, every branch | drops | forwarded by name |
| `min`, `max`, `minLength`, `pattern` | each one's `FormField` TSDoc in `@object-ui/types` says the built-in `input` branch puts it on the native control; the `form` docs page lists them under Validation | drops | forwarded by name (input host) |
| `rows` | `FormField.rows` TSDoc says the built-in `textarea` branch puts it on the textarea as `rows` | drops | forwarded by name (textarea host) |
| `step` | not declared (open on objectui#12130); `ObjectForm` writes it for a `widget: 'input'` number field, pinned by `objectFormNumericStep-9574.test.tsx` | drops | forwarded by name (input host) |
| `multiple`, `accept` | `ObjectForm` writes them for a `file` / `image` field it routes to the input with `inputType: 'file'` | drops | forwarded by name (input host) |
| `aria-*`, `data-*` | open families | keeps | unchanged |

  This keeps every documented or produced key on the control, so no published face narrows and `Clause-②: no` stands as the claim wrote it. The route is the one `form-control-dom-props.ts` prescribes for anything beyond its set ("DECLARE it and forward it by name"). The seat should still read the table above: it is a judgement about which keys have a reader. What stops reaching the control is every undeclared key (a misspelling, `autoComplete`, the canaries) and the declared keys whose docs name only a widget as reader (`capture`, `scale`, `span`, …), which have no effect on these hosts.
- **H4: the effects pin had no "drawn" assertion to flip.** It asserted only that the submit carries no value. It now also asserts that neither key is drawn (`shows()` for `defaultValue`, `anyInputChecked()` for `defaultChecked`), each with a control leg seeded through `FormSchema.defaultValues` that reads `true`, so the `false` is a reading. Those control legs stay green and still submit the value.

## The enumeration pin

`examples/schema-catalog/test/form-builtin-branch-dom-allowlist-12155.test.tsx`, the family's fourth after objectui#3291, #5574 and #5632:

- the arms are DERIVED from `renderFieldComponent`: its `switch (type)` is parsed with the TypeScript parser, every `case` label plus `default`, and the fixture table must name exactly that set;
- both registry sets: `@object-ui/fields` registered, then components only (every `field:` registration removed for that block), each with a registry control;
- each arm-exit is fed a canary key, a `defaultValue` and a `defaultChecked`, and none may reach the DOM;
- each arm-exit's legitimate set is asserted beside it: `name`, `aria-required`, the host attributes, the resolved `maxLength`, `placeholder`, a seeded value shown and an edit submitted (`value` + `onChange` by name), `readOnly` (or `disabled` for a toggle / select) and `disabled`.

## Reverse verification (all from committed state; each leg restored by `git checkout HEAD`, proven by blob hash plus an empty `git diff HEAD`)

- **Leg A, the BASE renderer under the new pins (run at `8afcce7`):** 19 failed / 27 passed. The new pin: 16 of 16 arm-exit cases red (the canary key reached the control; the file picker's form failed to render, which `eead810` now names with its own assertion). Legs B and C ran at `eead810`. The effects pin: `checkbox`, `switch` (hidden input checked) and `textarea` (drawn) red; `boolean` and every control leg green.
- **Leg B, allowlist replaced by an empty object (forwards nothing):** 16 failed / 3 passed, every one on `the field name reaches a form control`: the legitimate half fails where the leak half reads clean.
- **Leg C, `BUILTIN_HOST_ATTRIBUTES` picking nothing:** 12 failed / 10 passed: the input, textarea and default exits red on `min` / `rows`; checkbox, switch and select green; and `objectFormNumericStep-9574.test.tsx` red on both producer-route cases (`step` null). Without the by-name `step`, `ObjectForm`'s `widget: 'input'` number fields would refuse every decimal again.

Legs B and C ran through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed, restored to HEAD).

## Tests and gates (HEAD `eead810`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the three catalog pins plus `objectFormNumericStep-9574.test.tsx`: 4 files, 59 passed.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/` plus the four other component tests that render a `form`: 77 files, 590 passed, 17 skipped (the `runIf` zone-driven calendar and date-picker blocks).
- `packages/plugin-form/`: 175 files, 2146 passed, 1 skipped.
- catalog pins `form-field-channel-census-12130`, `form-control-dom-leak-5632`, `fields-form-hosted`, `catalog-gallery-render`, `smoke`: green.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` (echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/fields...'`.
- The two changed catalog pins, type-checked through a narrowed copy of `examples/schema-catalog/tsconfig.test.json` (`files` = those two): exit 0; a planted type error in the new pin turns it to exit 2. The package's full `type-check` needs every plugin built and is left to CI.
- eslint over the three changed TS files: 0 errors. `form.tsx` warnings 63 → 62 (one unused binding gone; `no-explicit-any` 55 → 55).
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:phantom-deps`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `docs:check-links`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-json`: exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`. Reason: its population floor needs the whole workspace built (25 packages unbuilt here), so the run proves nothing. The README edit below touches a table row, no fenced block.

## Surface notes

- `packages/plugin-form/README.md`: one table row cited `stripRendererOnlyProps` as the reason a form's `dataSource` never reaches the DOM. The helper is gone, so the row now names the allowlist. Taken as one of the claim's "docs pages that describe these fields' pass-through".
- Inside `form.tsx`, besides the spreads: the deleted blocklist's place now holds `BUILTIN_HOST_ATTRIBUTES`, and the comments that cited the blocklist by name are repointed.

## Acceptance notes

- Prose that still describes the old spread, outside this claim's surface and left alone (comments only, no behaviour). Carrier: none.
  - `form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx` and `form-field-channel-components-only-12130.test.tsx`: header sentences about the leftover keys reaching the control.
  - `packages/types/src/form.ts`: the line comment opening the "Field metadata written on the entry itself" block says the built-in branches spread the entry's remaining keys. The `rows` TSDoc says "spreads"; its effect still holds.
  - comments that cite `stripRendererOnlyProps` by name, listed by `git grep -l stripRendererOnlyProps -- packages/components/src` (`fullscreen-editor.tsx` and form tests); `ObjectForm.tsx` and `objectFormNumericStep-9574.test.tsx` say the input branch spreads `step` (it now forwards it by name, same effect).
- Observation: the `input` branch's file picker has never received `readOnly`, on BASE or here; the pin records that as a bound.
- `step` is still undeclared on `FormField` (open on objectui#12130). It is now a named entry in `BUILTIN_HOST_ATTRIBUTES` instead of an anonymous rider; a ruling there moves that entry with it.
